disposition_reason: Eighteen wild edible mushroom species (3-5 samples each) from 15 forest ecosystems of Dambovita County, Romania, analysed by EDXRF-FP for Fe, Cu, Zn, Mn, Ni, Cr, Pb and Cd; species means on a fresh-weight basis in Table 3.

study.design: Field collection of wild fruiting bodies
study.origin: 15 forest ecosystems in Dambovita County, Romania

period.as_reported: May to October of one unnamed year

study.method: Oven-drying 60 °C, pressed powder, EDXRF with fundamental parameters (ElvaX)
lod: Dry-matter LOD: Fe 2.0, Cu 0.5, Zn 1.0, Mn 0.8, Ni 0.3, Cr 0.2, Pb 0.1, Cd 0.05 mg/kg
study.qa: NIST 1575 pine needles recoveries 87.3-108.2%; Cr checked with chromium powder (90.2%); calibration with NIST 1573a and 1515
